title: Every Harness Will Become A Claw — Sam Bhagwat, Mastra
talk_summary: The talk is mostly a forward-looking industry framing with little concrete mechanism or measurement.

takeaways.what_they_do: Harnesses persist the stream and thread state so a run interrupted mid-turn can resume from where it stopped rather than restarting.
The harness automatically compacts the context window when it runs out rather than failing the turn.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it will autocompact when it runs out of the context window
It has a heartbeat which means it wakes up every you know defined amount of time and um and does something

takeaways.what_they_do: Agents review their own run traces and auto-generate reusable skills, a form of continual learning the speaker admits is unsolved.
takeaways.evidence_quote: skill automatic skill generation for example is a common one
